title: Vibrant Roasted Mexican Date Tacos
description: A flavorful and vibrant Mexican dish featuring roasted dates, perfect for a date night, served in a tagliere vessel, Jalisco-style, with a reduced sauce and dairy-free friendly ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lime juice, and tequila, if using.
Add the pitted dates to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Spread the dates on a baking sheet and roast for 20 minutes, or until tender.
While the dates are roasting, prepare the taco seasoning according to the packet instructions.
Warm the corn tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by placing a roasted date on each tortilla, followed by a sprinkle of taco seasoning and a garnish of chopped cilantro.
Serve the tacos in a tagliere vessel and enjoy.
Reduce the leftover marinade by cooking it over medium heat until it reaches the desired consistency.
Drizzle the reduced marinade over the tacos, if desired.
